summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a multi-tranche senior notes offering by its finance subsidiaries Teva Finance II, III, and IV, guaranteed by Teva. The filing describes new Euro- and USD-denominated notes due 2032-2037 with make-whole redemption and change-of-control repurchase provisions. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction, so the filing does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
